examples.title: Applied scenario
examples.scenario: Title: Anna Separates Repair from Apology Scenario: A release checklist lies beside the handoff doc and Anna's private notes app in a quiet conference room. She must decide whether to raise the late handoff as a process problem or as a disguised demand for an apology. She copies the useful goal into the agenda: agree on review-ready handoff by Thursday noon.
